author: Hume, 1869
summary: 국내에서는 2007년 2월 경남 진주에서 독수리 무리에 섞여 있던 어린새 1마리가 처음 확인된 길잃은새다. 히말라야와 티베트고원의 높은 산지에 살며 주로 동물의 사체를 먹고, 어린새는 겨울에 남쪽 저지대로 멀리 흩어지기도 한다. 벼랑에 무리 지어 둥지를 틀고 한 번에 알을 1개 낳는다.

points.ko: 흰 솜털로 덮인 머리와 긴 목(어린새)
points.en: head and long neck covered in whitish down (juvenile)
ruff of brown feathers at the base of the neck

points.ko: 흰 세로줄 있는 짙은 갈색 몸(어린새)
points.en: dark brown body boldly streaked whitish (juvenile)
whitish-streaked underwing coverts contrasting with blackish flight feathers

young: 어린새는 몸 윗면과 아랫면이 짙은 갈색에 흰 세로줄무늬가 뚜렷하고 날개깃과 꼬리가 거의 검어, 몸이 연한 황갈색인 어른새보다 훨씬 어둡게 보인다.

similar.how: 독수리는 온몸이 고른 흑갈색이지만, 고산대머리수리는 머리가 희끄무레한 솜털로 덮이고 목둘레 깃이 밝은 황갈색이며 몸에 흰 세로줄무늬가 있다.

art.subject: Himalayan Vulture (Gyps himalayensis), juvenile in its first winter, the age that wanders east in winter: body, back and wing coverts dark brown, boldly streaked buff-white on the underparts and with pale streaks on the upperwing coverts; a ruff of long, pointed brown feathers at the base of the neck; head and neck covered with whitish-grey down; flight feathers and tail blackish. Bill blackish; legs and feet grey.
art.pose: soaring on broad, deeply fingered wings held in a shallow V, seen from below
art.scene: Korean mountain ridges in winter with bare forest and patches of snow; no people, buildings or text
views: juvenile, side view standing hunched on open ground: huge vulture with a small head and long neck covered in whitish down, heavy hooked bill, a ruff of brown feathers at the base of the neck, dark brown body and wing coverts with bold whitish streaks, blackish flight feathers and short dark tail, strong legs

juvenile, in flight seen squarely from below: very long broad wings with deeply fingered primaries spread straight out to the sides to their full span, whitish-streaked dark underwing coverts contrasting with blackish flight feathers, dark brown streaked body, small whitish downy head on a long neck, short dark tail, feet tucked under the tail
art.build: Huge vulture, the largest griffon, comparable in size to a Cinereous Vulture, with a heavy body, long downy neck and small head. Bill large, deep and hooked, about as long as the head. Legs strong. Perched birds look hunched, with the neck tucked into the ruff. In flight very long, broad, parallel-edged wings with deeply fingered primaries, held in a shallow V when soaring; tail short, dark and slightly wedge-shaped.
avoid: Do not paint the uniform blackish-brown plumage and flat-winged soaring of Cinereous Vulture (Aegypius monachus); this griffon is streaked and soars with wings in a shallow V.
Do not paint a fully feathered head; the head and neck carry only short whitish down.
Do not give this juvenile the pale creamy body of the adult.
Do not leave out the ruff of long pointed feathers at the base of the neck.
